name: Estradiol cypionate
summary: Intermediate-to-long-acting injectable estradiol ester providing smoother serum levels than estradiol valerate injections.
advisory: Draw blood at trough immediately before the next scheduled weekly injection to evaluate steady-state levels.

combinations.note: Accelerates 17β-estradiol metabolism and lowers trough concentrations.

pharmacology.text: Estradiol cypionate is an estradiol ester, or a prodrug of estradiol. As such, it is an estrogen, or an agonist of the estrogen receptors. The affinity of estradiol valerate for the estrogen receptor has been reported to be 50 times less than that of estradiol, and estradiol valerate and estradiol cypionate have been found to possess similar affinity for the estrogen receptor.

body.says: Cleavage via esterases in the liver, blood, and tissues
Estradiol, cypionic acid, and metabolites of estradiol

uses.text: The medical uses of estradiol cypionate are the same as those of estradiol and other estrogens. Examples of indications for the drug include hormone therapy and hormonal contraception. In regard to the latter, estradiol cypionate has been used in combination with medroxyprogesterone acetate as a combined injectable contraceptive.

sideEffects.text: Side effects of estradiol cypionate include breast tenderness, breast enlargement, nausea, headache, and fluid retention.
